program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    asymmetric = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                        if (dy or dx) and 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] != 0 and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q)
                            stack.append(q)

            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            cell_set = set(cells)
            crop = [
                [grid[y][x] if (y, x) in cell_set else 0 for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
                for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)
            ]
            if crop != [row[::-1] for row in crop]:
                asymmetric.append(crop)

    assert len(asymmetric) == 1
    return asymmetric[0]
'''
